title: SRTM-derived 1 Second Digital Elevation Models Version 1.0
selection_reason: Nationally consistent authoritative elevation; smoothed surface reduces source-surface noise before regional slope derivation.
assurance_notes: GA/DEA metadata establishes publisher, product identity, resolution, units and CC BY 4.0 licensing.
Full VECA derivative has not been committed; the build records exact source URL and parameters in terrain_summary.json.
Synthetic regression tests verify slope mathematics and terrain-band boundaries independently of the remote DEM.
End-to-end acceptance requires a successful full-source build and broad known-location elevation sanity checks.
